notes.title: Anomaly Agent - Free Major Update, Rogue Agent Mode, Available Now!
notes.content:
Anomaly Agent's Roguelike mode, Rogue Agent, is available now!

[previewyoutube=rIG3P4NO9mM;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled by the interest you've shown in Anomaly Agent. Thanks to your support, we've had the chance to realize one of our dreams.

After releasing the game, we pondered how we could reciprocate this support. The idea came to us to create an additional mode for the game. We wanted to prepare a challenge mode that players who love the game and enjoy playing it could enter repeatedly and try out. Initially, this challenge mode was going to be about defeating waves of enemies in a simple manner. However, we decided to add some roguelike elements to make it more engaging and take it to a more enjoyable level.

In the end, you won't see entirely new things, but you'll notice that the existing elements of the game are presented in a different way.

We hope it's a mod you'll enjoy playing. Wishing you a lot of fun. Thanks again for your support.

notes.title: v.1.0.0.22 Hotfix
notes.content:
Due to an issue after the launch, we noticed that the "Treasure Hunter" achievement is not progressing as it should be for some players. After installing this update, when you open the game and reach the Main Menu, the achievement should be correctly updated on the Steam.

There are a total of 28 chests in the game. If you haven't deleted your game progress after opening all the chests, the achievement should unlock when you enter the game after the update.
